title: Initiating Removal from Operational Symptoms in Federated Vehicular Networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.22584v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Connected vehicles train a driving model through federated learning (FL) and drive with it, so a faulty contribution often surfaces only as a delayed symptom on the road. Federated unlearning (FU) assumes that a removal request names what to forget. A symptom names no vehicle or round, and aggregation has already spread its cause across the fleet. We propose \underline{A}ggregation-\underline{T}ime \underline{O}perational-evidence \underline{N}eutralization of \underline{E}ffects (\method{}), which makes unlearning a term of the FL aggregation rule. \method{} projects everyday driving errors and reported symptoms onto a subspace spanned by recent global increments. It propagates the surviving effect of every contribution with curvature estimated from these increments and scores all contributions in one backward pass. A two-tier correction suppresses suspected effects in every round and eliminates confirmed ones after a one-round probe. W

translated_title: 联邦车联网中由运行症状触发的遗忘移除
translated_abstract: 网联车辆通过联邦学习（FL）训练驾驶模型并用其驾驶，因此错误的贡献往往只在道路上以延迟出现的症状形式暴露出来。联邦遗忘（FU）通常假设移除请求会明确指明要遗忘的内容，而运行症状既不指明具体的车辆也不指明具体的训练轮次，且聚合过程已经将其成因扩散到整个车队中。为此，我们提出聚合时运行证据效应中和方法（ATONE），将遗忘变为联邦学习聚合规则中的一项。该方法将日常驾驶错误和上报的症状投影到由最近全局增量张成的子空间上，利用从这些增量中估计的曲率传播每个贡献的残留效应，并在一次反向传播中为所有贡献评分。一个双层校正机制在每一轮中抑制疑似效应，并在一轮探测后消除已确认的效应。
tldr: 本文提出ATONE方法，将联邦遗忘嵌入联邦学习聚合规则中，无需移除请求指明具体车辆或轮次，即可由车辆运行症状触发，通过将症状投影到最近全局增量张成的子空间来评分并中和错误贡献的有害效应。
en_tdlr: ATONE embeds federated unlearning into the FL aggregation rule, enabling removal triggered by operational symptoms—rather than explicit requests—by projecting symptoms onto the subspace of recent global increments to score and neutralize faulty contributions across the fleet.
